unit.why: A short memorate: a disciple overheard the Seer of Lublin after midnight, before his study, weeping and pleading in self-abasement. It is quoted to support a homiletic point about humbling oneself and repenting before Torah and prayer.
unit.boundary_note: One numbered excerpt (סו) in a chain of quotations from the same source; the narrative core is minimal and framed by a teaching.

stories.start_quote: כמו שהזהיר אותנו רבינו הק' מוהרי״י מלובלין
stories.end_quote: בנקל יוכל לדחות לשאול תחתית ח״ו
stories.summary_en: A disciple heard the Seer of Lublin, after midnight and before his study, fear that he was among the wicked to whom God says 'what hast thou to declare My statutes'; he wept, pleaded, and declared that he would not believe even an angel who called him righteous.
